summary: Two hikers stuck and unable to continue on snow-buried Barr Trail after the March storm (~4 ft of snow); snowcat extraction in the dark, both returned to safety
location: Barr Trail near Manitou Springs, Pikes Peak
responding_agency: El Paso County Search and Rescue
notes: Date approximate: advnture.com article (updated 2024-03-21) says the dispatch was 'yesterday morning' — 2024-03-20; second Barr Trail mission that week after the 2024-03-15 sick-hiker extraction. 2026-09-18: merged EPCSAR FB post (Barr Trail snowcat mission).
